Can you return the `mapped_rxn` associated with the template that, when applied to the molecule below (provided as available input data), reproduces the reaction: The Still-Gennari reaction is a modification of the Horner-Wadsworth-Emmons (HWE) reaction that allows for the selective formation of (Z)-alkenes from aldehydes and phosphonate esters. Additionally, the triple bond of an alkyne is changed to a single bond..
